text: The showcases of this chapter are available as an executable notebook, updated for the current API (API v1, pydracor 3): [ExploreCor Showcases: Using DraCor](https://dracor-org.github.io/dracor-notebooks/explorecor-showcases/explorecor-showcases.html) in the DraCor Notebooks ([source](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-notebooks/tree/main/explorecor-showcases)).

This chapter describes the legacy DraCor API (version 0.87.1 at the time of writing). Since API 1.0.0 (December 2023) all paths start with `/api/v1`, `/play/` became `/plays/`, and several fields were renamed (e.g. `cast` became `characters`); [D7.4 §3.2](#clsinfra-d74-3-2) describes the changes. The URLs without version prefix shown here still work at the time of checking, but will stop working when the legacy API is shut down ([#15](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-tech-reports/issues/15)). Current version: API 1.4.1, see the [current API documentation](https://dracor.org/doc/api). The code references (\<N\>) point to the code at the time of the report; some functions have since been renamed or removed.

The API URLs in this section use the legacy API (0.x) without a version prefix. They still work at the time of checking, but will stop working when the legacy API is shut down ([#15](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-tech-reports/issues/15)). Since API 1.0.0 (December 2023) the paths start with `/api/v1` and use `/plays/` instead of `/play/`; see [D7.4 §3.2](#clsinfra-d74-3-2) and the [current API documentation](https://dracor.org/doc/api).

DTS has since been implemented in the DraCor API ([API 1.1.0](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-api/releases/tag/v1.1.0), July 2025); see [D7.4 §3.4](#clsinfra-d74-3-4).

This chapter describes the front end at the time of the report (dracor-frontend 1.x, JavaScript). The front end has since been rewritten in TypeScript (version 3); the components referenced here exist under new file names (e.g. `Sapogov.tsx`, `Yarkho.tsx`, `PlayMetrics.tsx`), and the code references (\<N\>) show the state of the report. The API URLs in this chapter use the legacy API without version prefix, which will be shut down ([#15](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-tech-reports/issues/15)); see [D7.4 §3.2](#clsinfra-d74-3-2).

poecor.org was shut down in November 2026, and the POSTDATA server referred to in this section is no longer reachable. The code of the demonstrator is archived: [poecor-api](https://github.com/dracor-org/poecor-api) ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.24274702](https://hdl.handle.net/10.5281/zenodo.24274702)), [poecor-frontend](https://github.com/dracor-org/poecor-frontend) ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.24274705](https://hdl.handle.net/10.5281/zenodo.24274705)) and [postdata-2-dracor-api](https://github.com/dh-network/postdata-2-dracor-api), the state described here ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.24274974](https://hdl.handle.net/10.5281/zenodo.24274974)).
